description: A failure related to some mechanical defect but where no further details are known
name: General

description: External and internal leakage, either liquids or gases: If the failure mode at equipment unit level is coded as “leakage”, a more causally oriented failure mechanism should be used wherever possible.
name: Leakage

description: Abnormal vibration: If the failure mode at equipment level is “vibration”, which is a more causally oriented failure mechanism, the failure cause (root cause) should be recorded wherever possible.
name: Vibration

description: Failure caused by faulty clearance or alignment
name: Clearance /alignment failure

description: Distortion, bending, buckling, denting, yielding, shrinking, blistering, creeping, etc.
name: Deformation

description: Disconnection, loose items
name: Looseness

description: Sticking, seizure, jamming due to reasons other than deformation or clearance/alignment failures
name: Sticking

description: A failure related to a material defect but no further details known
name: General

description: Relevant for equipment such as pumps and valves
name: Cavitation

description: All types of corrosion, both wet (electrochemical) and dry (chemical)
name: Corrosion

description: Erosive wear
name: Erosion

description: Abrasive and adhesive wear, e.g. scoring, galling, scuffing, fretting
name: Wear

description: Fracture, breach, crack
name: Breakage

description: If the cause of breakage can be traced to fatigue, this code should be used
name: Fatigue

description: Material damage due to overheating/burning
name: Overheating

description: Item burst, blown, exploded, imploded, etc.
name: Burst

description: Failure related to instrumentation but no details known
name: General

description: No, or faulty, regulation
name: Control failure

description: No signal/indication/alarm when expected
name: No signal /indication/alarm

description: Signal/indication/alarm is wrong in relation to actual process. Can be spurious, intermittent, oscillating, arbitrary
name: Faulty signal/indication/alarm

description: Calibration error, parameter drift
name: Out of adjustment

description: Faulty, or no, control/monitoring/operation due to software error
name: Software error

description: Several instrument items failed simultaneously, e.g. redundant fire and gas detectors; also failures related to a common cause
name: Common cause/Common mode failure

description: Failures related to the supply and transmission of electrical power, but where no further details are known
name: General

description: Short circuit
name: Short circuiting

description: Disconnection, interruption, broken wire/cable
name: Open circuit

description: Missing or insufficient electrical power supply
name: No power/voltage

description: Faulty electrical power supply, e.g. overvoltage
name: Faulty power/voltage

description: Earth fault, low electrical resistance
name: Earth/isolation fault

description: Failure caused by some external events or substances outside the boundary but no further details are known
name: General

description: Flow restricted/blocked due to fouling, contamination, icing, flow assurance (hydrates), etc.
name: Blockage/plugged

description: Contaminated fluid/gas/surface, e.g. lubrication oil contaminated, gas-detector head contaminated
name: Contamination

description: Foreign objects, impacts, environmental influence from neighbouring systems
name: Miscellaneous external influences

description: Failure mechanism that does not fall into one of the categories listed above
name: General

description: Failure investigated but cause not revealed or too uncertain
name: No cause found

description: Several causes: If there is one predominant cause this should be coded
name: Combined causes

description: No code applicable: Use free text
name: Other

description: No information available
name: Unknown
